caption: Chocolate sprinkles are scattered over hot buttered toast, and they soften and smear into dark streaks.

sa.check: Chocolate sprinkles are scattered over hot buttered toast.
The sprinkles soften and lose their hard edges.
The sprinkles smear into dark streaks.
The sprinkles go glossy where they touch the toast.
The sprinkles are separate hard grains at the start.
The softening comes first and the smearing follows.

pc.expect: Each sprinkle loses its stick shape from the bottom up and spreads into a low streak, and neighbouring streaks may join.
pc.fail: A sprinkle keeps its sharp stick shape while glossy and spread; or a sprinkle's edges sharpen as it melts; or a sprinkle turns into a hard bead that stays whole; or the sprinkles rise into standing spikes.

pc.expect: The softening only advances and the streaks do not harden into grains again on the hot toast.
pc.fail: A streak draws back into a hard sprinkle; or the sprinkles set firm and matt again on the hot toast; or the sprinkles alternate between hard and soft; or a streak's edges pull inward and it stands taller.

pc.expect: The melted chocolate spreads into the toast's surface and runs to its low places and off its edge.
pc.fail: A streak climbs the toast's crust and stays; or melted chocolate lifts off the toast; or a streak runs uphill on a tilted slice; or the chocolate gathers on the crust's high rim and stays.

pc.expect: The sprinkles soften where they touch the hot toast, going glossy from underneath, and the toast's surface darkens where they lie.
pc.fail: A sprinkle softens on its upper side while its underside stays matt and hard; or a streak appears on a part of the toast no sprinkle touched; or the sprinkles soften while the toast stays pale and dry under them.

pc.expect: The sprinkles on the toast are the sprinkles that were scattered; none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A sprinkle vanishes; or new sprinkles appear on the toast; or a streak grows with nothing added; or a sprinkle passes through the toast.

pc.expect: The toast's crust, the plate and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The toast's crust changes shape; or the plate changes pattern; or items around the plate rearrange.
